summary.intent: Land and verify parallel PR branches for the monokl search tool, then reorganize Entire trails so they represent project intent rather than per-PR wrappers, clean up stale worktrees/branches, and start the next set of parallel work.
summary.outcome: Found that merging #87 and #88 broke main's test compile (removed `matched_keywords` field still used in scaling.rs) and opened fix #90. Created six intent trails (361-366), removed 31 worktrees, closed 7 trails and deleted 105 merged local branches, and launched four parallel tracks (decision-log, one-language-definition, docs-match-binary, adr-spans). #90 could not be moved under its intended intent trail.

repo: Each PR is tested against main alone in CI, so two branches that merge cleanly as text can still break main when combined (a field deleted in one and constructed in another). This happened with #68/#69 and again with #87/#88.
`just ci` covers coverage and scaling tests; other recipes include `just machete`, `just typos`, and `just check-drift`, with a harness whose numbers must remain unchanged for code changes.
Older trails were named by outcome (e.g. 'The public API is as small as the product', 'Comments say why, never history', 'The checker is the type authority') and collected multiple changes toward it.
Rejected two-phase search prototype is on branch `experiment/two-phase-search` with uncommitted changes; its numbers are recorded in ADR 0004.
The release PR #59 regenerates after each merge, so its changelog should be read before suggesting a merge.
Six places currently list language extensions and test-file rules; the planned work consolidates them and drops `Language::Python` plus a redundant bridge enum.

code.finding: Constructs a `CodeBlock` with `matched_keywords`, a field deleted by #87. This caused the `no field named matched_keywords` compile failure on main after both #87 and #88 merged; #90 removes this line.

workflow: Verifying parallel branches requires compiling and running the full suite on the combined state, not just checking that they merge textually; agent reports of 'merges cleanly' were true only as text.

Entire trails should represent an intent/outcome with 'done when' evidence and 'what we learned', with PRs as changes inside them. Use `entire trail link <trail> --branch <branch>` from the first push rather than creating one trail per PR.

Entire refuses to unlink a change from its trail ('reparent instead') and refuses to link one that already belongs to another trail; no reparent command was found in the CLI help, so changes must be placed under the right trail from the start.
Cleanup was done with dry-run scripts first, then applied, and only merged, clean worktrees and branches already in main were removed.
A merge queue or requiring branches to be up to date before merging would catch combined-state breakage that per-PR CI misses.
Parallel agent tracks were assigned to non-overlapping files, based from main plus #90's fix, and judged by exit codes.

friction: Merging #87 and #88 broke main's test compile; main's CI was still in progress for the #87 merge and the #88 run was cancelled.
The agent initially created one trail per PR, so trails lost their semantic grouping and needed correcting.
Entire would not reparent #90's change from per-PR trail 350 to intent trail 366, and the CLI help showed no reparent operation.
Merged PRs' changes remain attached to their old per-PR trails, so the new intent trails can only list them in a comment.
open_items: Merge #90 (one-line fix for main's broken scaling test); main's tests stay red until then.
Release PR #59 needs its changelog read before a merge decision.
Fold decision-log entries for #86 to #88 into a docs PR after #90 lands (track decision-log, entries 35 to 38, now running).
Span-based model refactor waits for ADR 0005 (adr-spans track).
The 'structure from the AST' PR (a `name` field on blocks and a typed `ParsedTerm`) should follow the language-definition PR.
Hooks member rows deferred because the harness shows no need.
Enable a merge queue or 'branch must be up to date' repository setting (user's decision).

Decide whether to delete `experiment/two-phase-search`, and review the first-release worktree, the two older checkouts, and the locked `core-types-match-rules` and `pin-survivors` worktrees, which were left in place.
